verdict.rationale: Convex documents per-developer dev deployments: the CLI watches the filesystem and pushes schema changes there, and deployments can also run locally. Its official MCP server lets agents work with deployments but is blocked from production by default, which gives agents an isolated place to iterate on schema changes before production. However, preview deployments appear only as a bullet on the pricing page, and no docs describe an agent creating a branch or preview environment, validating a schema migration there, and promoting it. Missing for 10: documented preview/branch deployment workflow, explicit schema-migration validation and promotion steps, agent-driven preview creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
